hooks.name: Docs commit on save
hooks.description: Commits README.md and docs/*.md saves with a standardized docs commit message summarizing the change.

action.prompt:
A markdown doc file (README.md or a .md file under docs/) was just saved. Stage only that file (git add <path>) and commit it locally with the message:

docs: update <filename>

<one- to three-line summary of what changed, derived from `git diff --cached` for this file>

Use the file's base name (e.g. README.md, setup.md) in place of <filename>. Do this without asking for confirmation. Do NOT run `git push` or contact any remote. If the file is untracked by git or there are no actual changes staged, skip silently without reporting an error.
